Stadler, Europe’s largest tungsten scrap trader and part of the Plansee Group, plays a key role in securing secondary raw materials through buy-back programs and scrap collection systems.

In addition to supply agreements with tungsten mines in Central America and the Iberian Peninsula, the Sangdong mine in South Korea is set to become a strategic asset. Operated by Almonty Industries, it holds one of the world’s largest tungsten reserves and is expected to supply up to 20% of all non-Chinese tungsten ore concentrates. As the largest shareholder with >10%, the Plansee Group has secured its supply of tungsten concentrates from the Sangdong mine through long-term purchase agreements
